whatIsIt.title: What is Intent Engineering?
whatIsIt.description: INTENT.md is your long-term intent anchor — recording your goals, non-negotiable boundaries, and when to stop and escalate. It helps PD align with your true intent at key decision points.

whyYouFill.title: Why do you need to fill it in?
whyYouFill.description: Intent is Owner-owned. PD will not auto-generate intent because only you know the project's real goals and boundaries. This is your decision authority; PD only helps you execute and align.

sectionGuide.title: 5-section guide

sections.desiredOutcome: Desired Outcome — the specific results you want to achieve
sections.nonNegotiables: Non-Negotiables — boundaries that must never be violated
sections.stopEscalation: Stop / Escalation — when to stop the current action and escalate to you

debt.subtitle: Review active principles that may be stagnant, never activated, or flagged as technical/behavioral debt.

welcome.title: Welcome to Principles Disciple
welcome.subtitle: Turn your repeated corrections into reviewed, reversible principles.
welcome.stateSaveError: Couldn't save onboarding progress. Check browser storage permissions and retry.

step1.title: What is PD?
step1.description: An owner-governed behavior internalization system. PD turns behavioral evidence into reviewed, reversible principles that shape future agent behavior.

step2.title: See the full governance loop in action
step2.description: This is a controlled demo using simulated evidence. In real use, your agent produces evidence through the pd-pain-signal skill.
step2.demoSimulatedNote: This evidence is simulated for demo purposes.

step3.title: Essential Slash Commands
step3.description: Type these commands in your agent conversation to control PD.
step3.commandsIntro: Here are 7 core commands. Type /pd-help for the full list.

commandDescriptions.pdHelp: Show all commands and usage guide

step3.emptyListFallback: Failed to load command list. Type /pd-help to see all commands.

step4.title: Ready to record real evidence
step4.description: When your agent makes a mistake or you repeatedly correct it, tell the agent: 'Use pd-pain-signal to record this.'
step4.examplePromptText: I just corrected you on X. Use pd-pain-signal to record this as a pain signal.
step4.windowHint: We'll check back in 2 hours. No pressure — you can always record evidence later.
step4.pollingActive: Listening for evidence... We'll check every 30 seconds for 2 hours.
step4.evidenceFound: Evidence detected! You can now review it in the Focus page.
step4.timeoutHint: No evidence detected in 2 hours. That's okay — you can record evidence anytime with pd-pain-signal.
step4.pollingError: Couldn't check for evidence. The evidence service may be unavailable.

failedTasks.recoverConfirmForceImpactDesc: Force-reset the task: clear its error and lease, raise the retry budget by 3, and create a new execution attempt. Existing artifacts are preserved.
failedTasks.recoverSuccess: Recovery accepted — the task is pending again
